supersedes_for_transformed_arms: jo-command-direction-protocol-v1 (a7e804f2); v1 evidence stays as recorded
question: In the D3 open-loop setting, with each admitted coordinate limited only by its own live decoder range, is the post-tilt ON command change that topples an OFF-posture body effective through its direction (sign and pattern) or only through its size?
not_claimed: physiological validity of POST_NEG or POST_SCRAMBLE

measures.fall: D3 rule: tilt (antennal_gravity_live.body_angles[0]) >= 45 deg at any stored state 5006-20000 -> FALLS, else STAYS_UP
measures.also_reported: peak tilt after state 5005; largest commanded step at the tilt; per admitted coordinate the largest excursion beyond [min(ON, OFF), max(ON, OFF)] at the same transition; per arm the number of transitions with a commanded change > 0.002 rad (the largest change the live pipeline can make between consecutive neural updates, 4 rad/s x 0.5 ms); v1 vs v2 outcome per arm from the v1 report (descriptive)

labels.prerequisite: the source's v1 POST_ONLY outcome (from the v1 report) is FALLS
labels.consistency: within G1 (3 sources) and within FLIP (2) separately: CONSISTENT if identical for every source, else MIXED; no pooling

integrity.Z1_complete: all 15 arms COMPLETE with 20001 samples and 4000 ticks
integrity.Z2_pretilt_anchor: each arm's qpos equals the v1 POST_ONLY arm of its source at every stored state 0-5005 exactly
integrity.Z3_yoke_audit: every arm's recorded commanded_joints at state n+1 equals the declared schedule row n exactly for n = 0..19999; adhesion recorded all zero
integrity.Z4_gravity: recorded gravity (0,0,-9810) for states 0-5005 and exactly R_y(-20 deg) @ (0,0,-9810) from 5006; no applied body wrench; zero external and generalized applied maxima

design_expectations.disclosure: written after seeing v1's confounded outcomes (NEG and HALF stayed up, SCRAMBLE fell, all with pinned middle legs); carried over verbatim from v1, not revised; not blind
design_expectations.E1: POST_NEG STAYS_UP in at least 4 of 5 fallen sources
design_expectations.E2: POST_HALF STAYS_UP in all 5 fallen sources
design_expectations.recording: each HELD or NOT_HELD; evaluated only when INTEGRITY_ACCEPTED

declared_interpretation.DIRECTION_SPECIFIC_and_PATTERN_SPECIFIC: the fallen arms' JO-driven post-tilt change has a specific destabilising direction in this open loop
declared_interpretation.DIRECTION_NONSPECIFIC: a change of that size topples the body in either direction; the falls say nothing about the sign of the JO response
declared_interpretation.DIRECTION_SPECIFIC_with_PATTERN_NONSPECI: reversing the change prevents the fall but another direction of the same size does not; the reversed direction is special, rather than the original being uniquely destabilising
declared_interpretation.v1_vs_v2: descriptive only: what pinning the middle legs did; nothing about the JO route

interpretation_limits: Open loop: the mixed streams never occurred in a closed loop.

POST_NEG and POST_SCRAMBLE are probes, not physiology: values up to about 0.26 rad outside anything the live session produced at that transition, the same step at the tilt as POST_ONLY, and changes that can exceed the live slew limit; all reported.
No clip means no joint-limit protection: the leg joints are compiled unlimited; ON commands already reach 1.99 rad.
One scramble vector, reused from v1: a single sample of another direction.
The expectations are not blind (see disclosure).
Five fallen sources; labels per source, no statistics.
Step D limits apply (idealised gravity step, modelled JO transduction).
No motor coordinate status change (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: All 15 arms run once after protocol, code and tests are committed and pushed; evaluated once.
